description_excerpt: Job Description Performs the test in compliance with the clients provided manuals and SOP's. Performs a regular checking of the equipments to be used (calibration and verification compliance). Keeps abreast of the updated test standards and procedures. Communicates with Customer service staffs for any unclear information that will affect the testing. Communicates with Report team for all information related to test results.
